register.labelZh: PLUNGE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: plunge in 和 plunge into the water 可以表示迅速而有力地跳入或跌入水中。；你可以使用 PLUNGE 描述把食物、工具或其他物件迅速放進水、顏料或其他物料中。；plunge into debt、crisis 或 chaos 可以表示某人、地方或機構突然陷入困難。；The town plunged into darkness 描述發生了甚麼事;The power cut plunged the town intodarkness 則同時說明事情的原因。
register.summaryEn: Plunge in and plunge into the water show a quick and forceful jump or fall. You can use PLUNGE when food, tools or other objects are quickly pushed or placed into water, paint or another material. Plunge into debt, crisis or chaos shows that a person, place or organisation enters a difficult situation very quickly. The town plunged into darkness describes what happened. The power cut plunged the town into darkness also explains what caused it.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Notice the three different ideas: The swimmers plunged into the pool. The cook plunged the vegetables into cold water. The power cut plunged the street into darkness. Use in when the place is already clear. Use into when the sentence names the place or situation: The water is ready. Plunge the vegetables in. Plunge the vegetables into the water.
